nc.description: A grey, clay-like mechanical model features a gear attached to an arm that surrounds a central white cylinder within an arched frame.
A light-colored mechanical claw structure is breaking apart into small cubes on its left side.
A 3D rendering displays a plain grey mechanical assembly featuring a lever connected by a hinge to an L-shaped bracket positioned next to a cylindrical wheel.

A 3D rendering shows a mechanical assembly where multiple grey, curved arms extend from one side of a central faceted collar, while white arms on the opposite side connect to a hinged rectangular plate.
Various light grey geometric blocks are arranged symmetrically on a white surface around a central, cross-shaped object.

vc.description: A monochromatic 3D rendering shows a pedal-powered, tracked mechanical device with a central gyroscopic structure and a large toothed wheel excavating a rocky incline.

A monochromatic rendering displays a mechanical assembly featuring gears, a chain, and caliper brakes situated between riveted, curved arms that emerge from draped material and connect to ribbed cylinders.
A metal cylindrical component of a wheel assembly is pressing into a knobby tire, causing the rubber to deform and rupture.
A light gray 3D rendering shows a static mechanical assembly consisting of interconnected rods, a central textured handle, and a semi-circular gear mechanism positioned next to a solid cube.
A collection of light grey mechanical components, including a central hub assembly surrounded by various brackets, ribbed plates, and circular discs, is arranged on a plain white surface.
